note: Amino-acid beads of the growing chain read Gly, Leu, Tyr, Ser, Leu, Gly, Ser, Ala from the free end down to the ribosome; Val sits on the incoming tRNA and Asn on the tRNA entering at the right. The departing tRNA at the left carries the stacked letters G, G, A and the incoming tRNA at the right carries U, U, A; those six single letters are listed in reading order interleaved with the nearby labels. The two tRNAs in the ribosome show anticodons C G U and C A A. The mRNA strand letters are given as one printed line. Prime marks transcribed as ASCII apostrophes.
